'''Sirden''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xyquine II]].<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sirden was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a<ref name="SoF" /> [[2014]]<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="SoF" />
